title: Zariski restriction of modules on a representable algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $T$ be a scheme over $S$, and let $h_T$ be its representable algebraic space [def-trf-algebraic-space] [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. Its identity map $h_T\to h_T$ is an object $e_T$ of its small etale site, using the representable etale scheme tests [lem-trf-space-representable-etale-scheme-tests]. Define the canonical Zariski restriction functor $R_T:\operatorname{Mod}(h_{T,\mathrm{et}},\mathcal O_{h_T})\to\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{Zar}},\mathcal O_T)$ by applying the existing scheme-chart restriction [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction] at $e_T$. Thus $(R_TM)(U)=M(U\to T\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}}h_T)$ on each Zariski open $U\subseteq T$, with the original module restriction maps and restriction of scalars by the canonical identification of regular functions on $U$ with those on its open subscheme. This defines the functor on all module sheaves, with no quasi-coherence hypothesis and no choice of a comparison module.
